title: Neb Adventure
description: A vanilla like Cobblemon adventure, adding vanilla+ mods and quality of life mods.
body:
Dive into a new **Cobblemon** Minecraft adventure with the **Neb Adventure** Modpack! This pack combines the thrilling Cobblemon experience with quality-of-life mods to enhance exploration, building, and gameplay.

- Cobblemon Integration: _Catch, train, and battle creatures across diverse biomes._
- Quality of Life Mods: _Improved inventory, crafting, and tools like minimaps and waypoints._
- Enhanced World: _Explore upgraded terrain, structures, and hidden treasures._
- Performance-Friendly: _Smooth, optimized gameplay for solo or multiplayer fun._

Embark on a seamless, immersive journey—perfect for trainers and adventurers that like the vanilla+ side of minecraft! 🌟
